BatterIQ Console

Install the console on your device

Scan the code or open the link on your phone or laptop, sign in, then follow the steps for your device below to add it like a real app.

iPhone / iPad

Safari only — Chrome on iOS can't install apps

Tap the Share button in Safari

Scroll down, tap "Add to Home Screen"

Tap Add, then open it from your home screen

Push notifications only start working once it's on your home screen (iOS 16.4+) — opening the Safari tab isn't enough.

Android

Chrome (or any Chromium browser)

Tap the ⋮ menu, top-right

Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"

Confirm — it lands in your app drawer

Windows / Mac

Chrome or Edge

Click the install icon in the address bar

…or ⋮ menu → "Install BatterIQ Console"

It opens in its own window from now on
